pages.heading: The Ugly Duckling
paragraphs: A story about finding where you belong.

pages.heading: The Nest
paragraphs: One warm morning, Mother Duck sat <v data-key="patiently">patiently</v> on her nest.
She was waiting for her eggs to <v data-key="hatch">hatch</v>.
“Soon, my little ducklings will be here,” she said happily.

pages.heading: The Ducklings Arrive
paragraphs: <v data-key="one-by-one">One by one</v>, the eggs began to open.
Tiny yellow ducklings came out and looked around.
But one big egg was still <v data-key="unbroken">unbroken</v>.

patiently.context: Mother Duck waited calmly for a long time.

hatch.context: When a baby bird comes out of its egg.

one-by-one.context: The eggs opened individually, not all at the same time.

unbroken.context: The large egg had not opened yet.
